description: End-to-end lifecycle for creating, configuring, publishing, managing, and retiring monetized API products and subscription plans

api_product_id.description: Identifier for a logical API product composed of one or more underlying APIs or endpoints

plan_id.description: Identifier for a specific monetization plan associated with an API product

subscription_id.description: Identifier for an active or historical subscription to a monetization plan

customer_id.description: Identifier for a tenant, organization, or developer who subscribes to an API plan

pricing_profile_id.description: Identifier for a reusable pricing profile that can be attached to one or more plans

billing_account_id.description: Identifier of the billing account or payment profile associated with a customer

usage_report_id.description: Identifier for a generated usage or revenue report

currency_code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, EUR

functions.name: create_api_product
functions.description: Create a new monetizable API product and define its base configuration

name.description: Human-readable name of the API product

description.description: Detailed description of the API product and its use cases

owner.description: Information about the team or individual owning this product

ticket_queue.description: Support ticket queue name or ID

endpoints.description: List of API endpoints that make up this product

tag.description: Optional grouping tag for the endpoint

rate_limit_group.description: Logical group for applying shared rate limits

visibility.description: Visibility and access control for the product

allowed_tenants.description: Tenant IDs allowed to see or subscribe to this product when access_type is restricted

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for the product

tags.description: Searchable tags to categorize the product

functions.returns: Created API product details including api_product_id and initial status

functions.name: create_pricing_profile
functions.description: Define a reusable pricing profile that can be attached to multiple plans

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the pricing profile

billing_interval.description: Primary billing interval for recurring charges

fixed_fees.description: List of fixed recurring or one-time fees

amount.description: Monetary amount in the specified currency

interval.description: How often the fee is charged; relevant for recurring fees

metric.description: Usage metric that the tier applies to

unit_price.description: Price per unit within this tier in specified currency

up_to.description: Inclusive upper bound of units for this tier; null or omitted = unlimited

start_after.description: Exclusive lower bound, typically previous tier's upper bound

aggregation_window.description: Window over which usage is aggregated for tiering

overage_policy.description: Policy that applies when usage exceeds included limits

overage_unit_price.description: Per-unit price for overage when strategy is pay_as_you_go

throttle_config.description: Throttling configuration when strategy involves throttling

max_rps.description: Maximum allowed requests per second after throttling

grace_units.description: Additional units allowed before blocking when using grace_then_block

duration_days.description: Length of the free trial in days

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for this pricing profile

functions.returns: Created pricing profile details including pricing_profile_id

functions.name: create_monetization_plan
functions.description: Create a monetization plan for an existing API product using a pricing profile or inline pricing config

plan_code.description: Unique internal code for this plan

plan_type.description: High-level monetization type for this plan

inline_pricing.description: Inline pricing configuration if no pricing_profile_id is supplied

base_fee.description: Base recurring fee per billing interval

included_requests.description: Number of requests included per interval

eligibility.description: Eligibility rules for who can subscribe

geo_restrictions.description: List of ISO country codes allowed or blocked

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the plan

functions.returns: Created plan details including plan_id and status

functions.name: publish_monetization_plan
functions.description: Transition a draft monetization plan to a published state and optionally notify eligible customers

effective_from.description: When the plan should become available for new subscriptions

publish_scope.description: Environments in which this plan will be available

migration_policy.description: How existing subscribers on related plans should be handled

proration_strategy.description: How to handle partial billing cycles during migration

functions.returns: Updated plan status, effective dates, and migration operations summary

functions.name: list_monetization_plans
functions.description: List and filter monetization plans across API products

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down plans

functions.returns: Paginated list of monetization plans with optional related entities

functions.name: get_plan_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of a specific monetization plan, including pricing and quota
functions.returns: Full monetization plan resource with pricing, quota, eligibility, and requested related data

functions.name: preview_plan_pricing
functions.description: Simulate charges and quotas for a hypothetical usage pattern under a given monetization plan

usage_scenario.description: Expected usage details for the preview window

window.description: Time window represented by the provided usage numbers

distribution.description: Optional distribution across endpoints or time

effective_date.description: Date for which pricing rules should be evaluated; defaults to now

functions.returns: Pricing preview including estimated recurring charges, variable charges, taxes (if configured), and quota utilization

functions.name: create_subscription
functions.description: Subscribe a customer to a monetization plan and bind it to a billing account

start_date.description: Start of subscription; defaults to now

trial_override.description: Override or disable plan-level trial configuration

api_key_configuration.description: Preferences for generated API keys or tokens

functions.returns: Created subscription details including subscription_id, status, and generated API keys if applicable

functions.name: get_subscription_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, usage, and billing state of a subscription

usage_window.description: Optional time window for usage summary

functions.returns: Subscription resource with lifecycle status, recent usage, billing state, and optional related data

functions.name: update_monetization_plan
functions.description: Update metadata, pricing, or quota of a monetization plan with versioning and backward compatibility controls

updates.description: Fields to update on the plan

compatibility_policy.description: How to apply changes to existing subscriptions

change_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the update for audit logs

functions.returns: Updated plan details, including new version and compatibility actions applied

functions.name: cancel_subscription
functions.description: Cancel or schedule cancellation of a subscription, with optional proration handling

proration_strategy.description: How to handle fees for unused time

retain_api_keys_until.description: If set, API keys remain valid until this time despite cancellation

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation including final billing summary and subscription end date

functions.name: retry_billing_operation
functions.description: Retry a failed billing or payment operation associated with a subscription and update its monetization state

operation_id.description: Identifier of the failed billing operation if known

failure_context.description: Context about the failure if no operation_id is provided

update_subscription_state_on_success.description: Whether to automatically re-activate a subscription if payment succeeds

functions.returns: Result of retry attempt, including updated billing operation status and subscription monetization state

functions.name: rollback_plan_change
functions.description: Rollback a recent plan update or migration in case of misconfiguration or customer impact

target_version.description: Plan version identifier to rollback to; if omitted, roll back one version

scope.description: Whether to only revert plan configuration or also remap subscriptions

subscription_filter.description: Optional filter to restrict which subscriptions are affected when rolling back subscriptions

reason.description: Human-readable reason for rollback for audit

dry_run.description: If true, only report what would be changed without applying

functions.returns: Rollback summary including affected versions, subscriptions, and any conflicts or skipped items

functions.name: generate_usage_report
functions.description: Generate a detailed usage and revenue report for monetized APIs over a given period

metrics.description: List of metrics to include in the report

group_by.description: Dimensions for grouping the report data

delivery.description: Optional configuration for delivering the generated report

functions.returns: Usage report metadata including usage_report_id, generation status, and access location or inline data if small

functions.name: bulk_import_monetization_plans
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple monetization_plans from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined monetization_plans, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_monetization_plans
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of monetization_plans matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped monetization_plans with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_monetization_plans
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of monetization_plans with retention metadata and audit reasons.

functions.name: bulk_export_monetization_plans
functions.description: Export a filtered set of monetization_plans to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.name: list_plan_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing plan subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_plan_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a plan subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.

functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single plan with field-level diffs and actor info.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across monetization_plans for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_plan_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of monetization_plans.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_plan_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to monetization_plans with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.name: cancel_plan_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight plan job, optionally interrupting running steps.

functions.name: simulate_plan_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a plan (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_plan_approval
